# Source: Polychrome Bowl with Abstract Geometric Motifs

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Polychrome Bowl with Abstract Geometric Motifs
- **Artist / culture:** Four Mile Polychrome Cibola region, east-central Arizona, United States
- **Date:** 1000–1400
- **Style:** four mile polychrome
- **Classification:** bowl
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 52787
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/52787
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/c416cdbc-23b3-055b-c136-1753b97ec2dd/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Geometric Abstraction

## Extracted source palette

`#B8B8B8, #D87848, #989898, #B85828, #684838, #885838, #787878, #B87858`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#36251D`
- `surface`: `#4D3E37`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#D87848`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#B85828`
- `surface_variant`: `#4D3E37`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#6C605A`
- `error`: `#D87848`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `mono` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `13.72:1`, surface `9.59:1`
- Variant contrast: `9.59:1`
- Control contrast: `6.24:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
